dashboard.title: Operations dashboard
dashboard.intro: Current platform-billing alerts. Opening a detail page never calls Mollie; it reads durable local recovery and audit state.
dashboard.terminalHelp: Provider mutations that stopped retrying in the last 24 hours.
dashboard.retryingHelp: Provider mutations waiting for another durable retry.
dashboard.pendingHelp: Incomplete provider mutations, including retrying work.
dashboard.oldestHelp: Age of the oldest incomplete provider mutation.
dashboard.webhooksHelp: Failures without a later successful delivery for the same payment.
dashboard.driftHelp: Subscriptions with repair flags, stale payments, or contradictory local states.
dashboard.loadError: The operations summary could not be loaded.

billing.title: Billing operations
billing.intro: Terminal, retrying, and pending payment-provider operations, ordered by urgency.

webhooks.title: Webhook failures
webhooks.intro: Failed webhook deliveries that have no later successful processing event for the same payment.

drift.title: Status drift
drift.intro: Local billing state that needs reconciliation or operator review. Provider status is refreshed by the scheduler, not by this page.
